Terms of Use

These terms apply when you use Know Your Mind, a personal reflection website operated by Rituraj Singh Ratan. You may use the site to complete check-ins and view your own reports.

What Know Your Mind offers

Know Your Mind summarizes your answers to help you reflect on patterns in how you think, feel and respond. The summaries depend on what you enter and may vary over time. Know Your Mind does not provide a diagnosis, medical advice, treatment or emergency support. For health decisions, speak to a qualified professional. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.

Accounts and saved reports

Creating an account is optional. Use only accounts you are authorized to use and keep access to your email and sign-in methods secure. Reports you choose to save stay in the browser where you saved them. Clearing site data or changing browsers can make those reports unavailable. See the Privacy Policy for details about local storage and account data.

Using Know Your Mind responsibly

Do not impersonate another person, attempt to access another person’s account, interfere with the site, or use someone’s responses or reports without their permission. Know Your Mind is designed for personal reflection. Do not use its results to make clinical, employment, insurance, education or other consequential decisions about someone.

Availability and changes

Know Your Mind may change its questions, reports or features, and access may be interrupted. If these terms change, the updated version will appear on this page. These terms do not limit rights you have under applicable law.

Contact

For questions about Know Your Mind or these terms, email riturajratan@gmail.com.
